newsitem.title: UK: FT/S&P indices to include Deutsche Telekom.
newsitem.headline: FT/S&P indices to include Deutsche Telekom.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG will be included in the FT/S&P Actuaries World Indices at its actual issued share capital weighting, now expected to be 22.8 to 25.3 percent on its second day of trade, the actuaries' policy committee said on Tuesday.

The announcement followed the German government's decision to increase Europe's largest-ever public share offering to 600 million shares of the telecom from 500 million. The FT/S&P-Actuaries Policy Committee said the increase would raise the level of Deutsche Telekom's issued share capital to 22.8 percent from 19.8 percent.

In addition, due to an over-allotment option, there is the possibility of a further 90 million Deutsche Telekom shares being issued, which could bring Deutsche Telekom's issued share capital to 25.3 percent, the committee said.
Deutsche Telekom said on Monday it would announce the share price for the offering on November 17, with dealing expected to begin on stock exchanges around the world the following day.

The committee said it would review its treatment of Deutsche Telekom and other very large privatisation stocks at its next regular meeting on December 5 prior to any further change in the weighting of the German telecommunications company.
The FT/S&P Actuaries World Indices are jointly compiled by FTSE International, Goldman, Sachs & Co and Standard & Poor's with the Institute of Actuaries and the Faculty of Actuaries.
